files.hooks/i18n.ts:
// Every word Ricky shows, in each language the `language` option offers.

export type Language = 'en' | 'zh'

export type Strings = {
  spinnerWords: string[]
  turnDone: (elapsed: string) => string
  commandDescription: string
  commandReply: string
  tasks: string
  subagents: string
  running: (n: number) => string
  calls: (n: number) => string
  recent: string
  filesChanged: string
  newFile: string
  edits: (n: number) => string
}

const EN: Strings = {
  spinnerWords: ['Ricky is casting', 'Ricky is stargazing', 'Ricky is chasing the moon', 'Ricky is weaving dreams', 'Ricky is reading the stars'],
  turnDone: elapsed => `✦ Ricky cast with you for ${elapsed}`,
  commandDescription: "Open Ricky's pixel pane",
  commandReply: 'Ricky is here ✦',
  tasks: '✦ Tasks',
  subagents: '✦ Subagents',
  running: n => `${n} running`,
  calls: n => `${n} call${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
  recent: '✦ Recent',
  filesChanged: '✦ Files changed',
  newFile: 'new',
  edits: n => `${n} edit${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
}

const ZH: Strings = {
  spinnerWords: ['Ricky 施法中', 'Ricky 摘星中', 'Ricky 追月中', 'Ricky 织梦中', 'Ricky 占星中'],
  turnDone: elapsed => `✦ Ricky 陪你施法了 ${elapsed}`,
  commandDescription: '打开 Ricky 的像素面板',
  commandReply: 'Ricky 来啦 ✦',
  tasks: '✦ 任务',
  subagents: '✦ 子 agent',
  running: n => `${n} 个运行中`,
  calls: n => `${n} 次调用`,
  recent: '✦ 最近动作',
  filesChanged: '✦ 改动文件',
  newFile: '新建',
  edits: n => `改 ${n} 次`,
}

export function stringsFor(language: unknown): Strings {
  return language === 'zh' ? ZH : EN
}

{
  "name": "ricky-pixel-mod",
  "version": "0.4.1",
  "description": "Ricky, a pixel-art cat companion for Claude Code: an animated night-sky pane with a task / subagent / activity / files board, a cat in the band above the prompt, and a purple-gold spinner",
  "author": {
    "name": "muxia23",
    "url": "https://github.com/muxia23"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/muxia23/ricky-pixel-mod",
  "license": "MIT (code only, see LICENSE)",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of Ricky's words: \"en\" (English, default) or \"zh\" (简体中文).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "en",
      "options": [
        "en",
        "zh"
      ]
    },
    "bandSize": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Band size",
      "description": "Ricky above the prompt. \"auto\" (default): the biggest that fits — 24px, 16px, or just the 8px head. \"large\" / \"medium\" / \"small\": cap it at 24 / 16 / 8 px (it still steps down when there is no room). \"off\": no band.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "large",
        "medium",
        "small",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "colors": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Colors",
      "description": "Text colours of the dashboard. \"auto\" (default): follow Claude Code's theme — dark themes get brighter colours; with \"Auto (match terminal)\" it asks macOS. \"light\" / \"dark\": always use the colours for a light / dark background.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "light",
        "dark"
      ]
    }
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
